rule.description: Account soft-deleted (Deleted = 1) but has open Req rows
rule.sql: SELECT a.Account_ID, 'Deleted = 1; open Req rows exist' FROM Accounts a WHERE a.Deleted = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Req r WHERE r.AccountID = a.Account_ID AND r.Deleted = 0 AND r.StatusText IN ('Open','Interviewing','Offer Made'))
